Read, type, fill and validate the two chart spec CSVs

read_chart_specs.Rd

The single entry point the driver should use. Reads both files via read_spec_csv (UTF-8 enforced, delimiter sniffed, everything as character), coerces the columns with known types (plot, dashed, dotted, stacked to logical; position, rolling, ylim_* to numeric; legend_columns to integer, likewise legend_columns_sl/_en — dates stay character for parse_spec_date), fills default aliases and, unless validate = FALSE, runs check_chart_specs.

Usage

read_chart_specs(charts_path, series_path, encoding = "UTF-8", validate = TRUE)

Arguments

charts_path

path to charts.csv

series_path

path to chart_series.csv

encoding

file encoding, default UTF-8

validate

run check_chart_specs (fail loud) before returning

Value

list with charts and chart_series tibbles
